white_panel.where: smooth white metal/composite panels: the tooth boxes, the upper NW/NE faces, top storey frames, podium fins and bands (sunlit earth_W3_whole)

slate_panel.where: dark charcoal blue-grey panels on the west end (W1/W2) and every SW-facing return of the teeth; Earth reads #3e5876-#4c6b8e through its blue cast, corrected by eye against the neutral whites (guess on exact value)

tower_brick.where: the two stair towers (west W1/U0 end, east W14/U2), the east service block and the east glazed block's ends (earth_corner_17, Lab 6.7 from brick_buff)

podium_glass.where: upper podium storey and box ribbons (reflective pale blue)

east_block_glass.where: teal-green glazing of the two-storey east block (W15) and the bridge band

skylight.where: sloped skylight along the NW and NE feet on B2/B1 roofs

slots.where: light reflective slot windows in the slate

geometry_notes: The SE footprint (W3-W14) traces the upper saw-tooth, but the two-storey podium (lidar ~10 m) fills the notches: it continues ~3 m in front of the SW returns W4, W7, W9 and W11, and its roof shows 1.5-3 m in front of the tooth faces W8, W10 and W12. In the drawing the podium storeys are put on the footprint walls; a podium polygon running roughly (903.6,159.2) -> (941,152.5) along the front would be truer.

Heights: short teeth W3-W10 ~19.2 m, full-height boxes W11-W14 and the main body ~23.9 m, podium ~10 m, east service block ~5.3 m (x 944-963, y 150-157), east glazed block ~9.6 m, bridge roof ~14.5 m.
The upper NW and NE faces (U0, U1) stand ~2.8 m inside the B2/B1 party lines W0/W18; the strip between is a sloped skylight at ~13.6 m over B2/B1's ~12.5 m roofs.
The east stair tower (24 m) has no footprint wall of its own on the SE: added as U2 (z0 5.3) behind the service block; its SW side is W14.
A taller (~27 m, lidar clipped at 26.9) blank block occupies the north corner (U0 s 0-8.5, U1 s 36.9-41.9), and a long white screen bar (~26.5 m) sits ~3-4 m behind U0 over s ~20-45.

W0.summary: party wall with B2 (B2 W3 s 7.4-74.6, coincident within 0.5 m) up to B2's roof (~12.5 m lidar, 13.1 in B2's spec); nothing of STC shows at this line. STC's upper NW face stands 2.8 m back from it: see U0
W0.notes: Lidar: 12.4-12.8 m 3 m outside (B2 roof), 13.4-14.0 m at 1.5 m inside (the sloped skylight), 23.6-26.7 m from 4 m inside. Wall colour follows B2's brick in case anything shows.

U0.summary: STC's NW face above B2's roof: smooth white panel wall with four broad projecting white pilasters (~4.4 m wide, ~10 m apart) and pairs of small dark windows low between them; a taller blank block at the north corner (s 0-8.5) and the buff-brick west stair tower at the SW end (s 54.6-63.8); a sloped glass skylight runs along its foot on B2's roof
attached: sloped glass skylight along the foot, s 8.5-54.6, on B2's roof: ~2.8 m deep, rising from ~12.6 m at its outer edge to ~14 m against this wall, dark blue-teal glass (glass_vault) in white mullions at ~1 m (earth_W0_m/r, earth_corner_25); it turns the north corner and continues along U1
U0.notes: earth_W0_whole/_l/_m/_r (2024); positions measured on earth_W0_whole scaled to the 63.8 m face. The pilasters flare slightly at the top and stop at ~24.6 m under a long white screen/fascia bar set back on the roof (top ~26.5 m, lidar 26.4-26.7 at 4 m inside for s 20-45): listed under roof. The north-corner block (s 0-8.5) rises to ~27 m (lidar clip 26.9); its windows are a guess from earth_corner_25 (two small windows, one per upper row). Window sill heights from earth_W0_m: centre ~16 m. Setback 2.8 m from W0 is from lidar (13.6 at 1.5 m in, 24 at 4 m in).

W1.summary: west end, north half: the buff-brick west stair tower (s 0-4.8, full height, a tall glazed slot near its south edge) beside the dark slate block; glazed ground storey under B2's flat concrete canopy
attached: B2's flat light-grey concrete canopy (B2 W2/W3) reaches the corner at ~4 m and continues ~3 m out along s 0-6 (lidar 4.1-4.3 m 3 m outside)
W1.notes: earth_W1_whole, earth_corner_0/1/2 (2024). The tower's brick reads #dbb8a3 sunlit (brick_buff, Lab 6.7). The slate block is topped by a white storey whose face is a white frame round a large recessed light panel (glass or pale infill, uncertain) from ~19.2 m (earth_W1_whole, earth_W2_whole). Slot windows are scattered, about two per storey per 5 m, and drawn from three staggered patterns; exact positions not countable on the mesh. Ground storey glazing is not visible (canopy shadow): guess.

W2.summary: west end, south half: dark slate panel block with scattered vertical slot windows (and a few small square ones), white top storey framing a recessed panel, glazed ground storey with the west entrance (guess) under the B2 canopy's end
W2.notes: earth_W2_whole, earth_corner_2/3 (2024). Slate panels read #3e5876 in Earth's blue cast; judged against the neutral white boxes they are a dark charcoal blue-grey (brick_slate, guess). Pairs of small square windows around mid-height (earth_W2_whole) are approximated by the l2/c cell. Entrance doors in the ground storey are a guess (no current street-level photo; Street View is Sep 2014, building under construction). One glazed double door (bay at s ~6.5-8.1) is a placeholder.

W3.summary: westmost tooth: white panel box (to ~19.5 m) with two ribbon-window storeys over the glazed two-storey podium; the main body's white top storey rises behind
W3.notes: earth_W3_whole, earth_corner_3/4. Lidar 19.4-19.8 at 1.5 m inside, 24 at 4 m. The SE front is a saw-tooth: white panel boxes with ribbon windows stand on a two-storey glass podium with white mullions/fins and white floor bands; the boxes' SW-facing returns are dark slate with slot windows. Lidar: podium roof ~10 m, short teeth ~19.2 m, tall teeth ~23.9 m. Earth 2024 (earth_corner_10-17) is the only current source.

W4.summary: short slate return of the W3 tooth over the podium
W4.notes: earth_W4_whole, earth_corner_4/5. The podium (~10 m) actually continues ~3 m out in front of this return (lidar 10.9 m 3 m outside at s 0.5); the slate return sits on the podium roof. The SE front is a saw-tooth: white panel boxes with ribbon windows stand on a two-storey glass podium with white mullions/fins and white floor bands; the boxes' SW-facing returns are dark slate with slot windows. Lidar: podium roof ~10 m, short teeth ~19.2 m, tall teeth ~23.9 m. Earth 2024 (earth_corner_10-17) is the only current source.

W5.notes: earth_W5_whole (bridge side, 2024): white/silver cladding top and bottom, glazed band in the middle with X bracing visible through the glass, underside white. Lidar roof 14.1-15.0. Underside height ~9.6 from earth_W5 proportions (guess, NH says ~9).

W6.notes: earth_corner_14/16/17 (2024) show this side over the road: white top and bottom bands, glazed band with white mullions. Lidar roof 14.4-15.3.

W13.summary: one-storey buff-brick service block (~5.3 m) with a dark overhead door and a white louvre box; behind it the full-height white box (three ribbon storeys) and a narrow glazed slot next to the east tower
attached: the 5.3 m service block is ~3-4 m deep in front of the tall box (lidar 5.3 at 1.5 m in, 10 / 24 at 4-8 m in)
W13.notes: earth_corner_17/20, earth_W13_whole, earth_W15_whole (2024): low brick block with a large dark door (loading/service, overhead type guessed) and a small white louvre box; a white trailer and van parked in front in 2024. W14.summary: SW side of the buff-brick east stair tower, blank, full height; the service block's brick at its foot
W14.notes: earth_W14_whole (shaded brick), earth_corner_18/19. Lidar 24 for s 0-3, 5.5 at s 4.5 (service block).

W15.summary: east end: the brick service block front (s 0-6.3, ~5.3 m) under the east tower, then the two-storey block with a teal-green glazed front between buff-brick ends and a white fascia (s 6.3-13.7, ~9.6 m)
W15.notes: earth_W15_whole, earth_corner_20-22 (2024).
